entities.name: War for Shandalar
entities.description: An event on Shandalar in which invading planeswalkers fought the plane's protector.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane rich in mana with unusual rules for drawing magic.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Planeswalker who escaped to Shandalar, claimed dominion, and died when an Astral dragon overwhelmed him with mana.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker invader, haunted by Sarpadia, who wished to freeze Shandalar.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who vowed to conquer Shandalar.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Planeswalker entombed in stone by Leshrac who reemerged with new powers and deceived Bani and Ravash disguised as Magus.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Protector of Shandalar who summoned an Astral dragon and was weakened in the fighting.

entities.name: Bani Bakur
entities.description: Leader who swore to kill Szat and destroy the invading planeswalkers.

entities.name: Ravash Mog
entities.description: Bani's sister, killed through Lim-Dûl's manipulation.

entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: Event after which Faralyn fled to Shandalar.

entities.name: Shadowwood
entities.description: Place where Bani and Ravash saved dark elves.

entities.name: Catacombs of Shandalar
entities.description: Place where Lim-Dûl reemerged and manipulated the sisters.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: War launched after twelve years of building an undead army.

events.summary: Faralyn escapes to Shandalar and claims dominion.
events.quote: Planeswalker Faralyn escaped from the Shard of the Twelve Worlds to Shandalar

events.summary: An Astral dragon summoned by Kenan Sahrmal overwhelms Faralyn with mana, causing him to explode.
events.quote: Faralyn's arrogance led to his death

events.summary: Leshrac entombs Lim-Dûl in stone for his failure, witnesses Faralyn's death, and vows to conquer the plane.
Bani and Ravash save dark elves from zombies in the Shadowwood.
events.quote: Bani Bakur and her sister Ravash Mog saved dark elves from zombies

events.summary: Leshrac meets Szat and the entombed Lim-Dûl in the desert, taunts Lim-Dûl and seemingly incinerates him.
events.quote: Leshrac taunted Lim-Dûl and seemingly incinerated him

events.summary: Lim-Dûl reemerges with new powers and, disguised as Magus, deceives Bani and Ravash into thinking he is Sahrmal.
events.quote: he deceived Bani and Ravash into thinking he was Sahrmal

events.summary: Lim-Dûl exploits Bani's fear with bats and causes Ravash's death by preying on her insecurity; Bani swears to kill Szat.
events.quote: causing Ravash’s death by preying on her insecurity

events.summary: Sahrmal is stunned by Szat's Infernal Darkness; Szat and Leshrac fight and both retreat from the plane.
events.quote: leading to both Planeswalkers retreating from the plane

events.summary: Lim-Dûl swaps bodies with Sahrmal as Bani strikes, and she decapitates Sahrmal's body; Sahrmal survives but is greatly diminished.
events.quote: the effort greatly diminished his powers for a time

events.summary: After her sister's funeral Bani rejects Lim-Dûl's impersonation; Lim-Dûl spends twelve years building an undead army before Lim-Dûl's War.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl spent the next twelve years building an undead army before launching Lim-Dûl's War

relations.quote: Bani Bakur and her sister Ravash Mog
entombing him in stone for his failure
causing Ravash’s death by preying on her insecurity

relations.note: summoned the Astral dragon that killed him
relations.quote: an Astral dragon summoned by Kenan Sahrmal overwhelmed him with mana
Bani, consumed by guilt, swore to kill Szat
